superload_thresholds.note: Missouri 'super heavy/large' handling is triggered when a non-divisible load exceeds any of: 16' wide, 16' high, 150' overall length, or 160,000 lbs gross (7 CSR 10-25.020). Oversize loads over 16' wide/high or 150' long also pay a $250 movement-feasibility (route/structural) fee; loads over 350,000 lbs on 2-lane require front+rear civilian escort.

width.note: 1 escort 12'6"-14' wide: rear on divided/multilane undivided, front on 2-lane (7 CSR 10-25.020)
14'-16' wide: 1 front + 1 rear on 2-lane and multilane undivided; 1 rear only on divided highways
over 16' wide: front + rear civilian escorts on divided/multilane; MSHP police escort required if over 16' on any 2-lane highway
MSHP police escort required over 18' wide on divided/multilane undivided (over 16' on 2-lane)

height.note: height-detection (pole) vehicle must precede loads over 15'6" high; satisfies front-escort requirement
MSHP police escort plus height-pole vehicle when over 17' high

length.note: rear escort when vehicle+load over 110' on all highways except divided
rear escort when over 125' combination on divided highways
MSHP police escort over 150' overall length

single_trip.fee_formula: Single-trip base = $15. Oversize over 16' wide/high or 150' long adds a $250 movement-feasibility (route/structural) fee. Overweight = $15 + $20 per each 10,000 lbs (or fraction) over legal gross weight, up to the routine 160,000 lb cap (7 CSR 10-25.020).
single_trip.note: One load; moves must be completed within 7 moving days.

annual.note: Annual/blanket: single-commodity oversize $128; multiple-commodity oversize $400; milk hauler $500; emergency overweight round-trip $624 — all prorated quarterly.

movement_restrictions: Daylight movement only: one-half hour before sunrise to one-half hour after sunset
Metro rush-hour ban Mon-Fri (e.g. St. Louis 6:30-9:00 a.m. and 3:30-6:30 p.m.; Kansas City analogous)
Holiday movement prohibited from noon on the last business day preceding the holiday
Nighttime overwidth movement allowed only up to 12'6" wide
notes: Base legal height is 13'6" on general highways; 14'0" is allowed on the interstate/designated and primary systems and within 10 air-miles thereof. Legal width 8'6", gross 80,000 lbs (bridge postings override lower).

Escort matrix, superload thresholds, fees, validity and curfews sourced from codified Missouri rule 7 CSR 10-25.020. Per-axle limits (single 20,000 / tandem 34,000 lbs, RSMo 304.180) not re-confirmed from a fetched MoDOT page this run.
State-level rules only — county/city permits, bridge-specific engineering and low-clearance routing are out of scope.
